latest.title: Tame polynomial automorphisms
latest.abstract: The group of polynomial automorphisms of the affine n-space is an interesting large group. A slightly simpler group is its subgroup of tame automorphisms. Natural problems about these groups include the existence of normal subgroups, the classification of finite subgroups, the Tits alternative, and the possible dynamical degrees of their elements. One method to investigate these questions is via some actions on some metric spaces, namely the coset complex and the valuation complex, that we introduce in detail. This paper is a survey focusing on the following three cases: dimension 2, dimension 3, and dimension 4 for tame automomorphism preserving a nondegenerate quadratic form.
latest.workSummary: 综述低维 tame 多项式自同构群，通过陪集复形和赋值复形上的作用讨论群论问题。
latest.breakthrough: 整理动力学次数、有限子群与 Tits 二择一等研究入口。
latest.limitations: 主要是综述而非新的统一分类定理。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
latest.priorityReason: 偏代数群与综述资源，和本组曲率及测度几何主线距离较大，宜后读。
